descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Consultanță și servicii de afaceri
We are looking for an experienced Network Security Engineer with a strong background in designing, configuring, and implementing network security solutions. The ideal candidate will be capable of designing and implementing robust security architectures to protect IT infrastructure against complex cyber threats.
 This role is equivalent to a Subject Matter Expert (SME) position in the field of Network Security.
 You will work closely with networking, network security, and IT teams to develop and optimize firewall and next-generation firewall (NGFW) solutions, leveraging advanced technologies (e.g. Palo Alto, Radware, Fortinet). 
 Key Responsibilities
 Network Security Solution Design, Implementation, and Training
Design security architectures for complex network environments, ensuring proper network segmentation and protection of data networks.
Configure and optimize firewall and NGFW solutions, implementing advanced security policies to control access and prevent cyber threats.
Provide technical support to pre-sales and sales teams, helping them identify and propose the most suitable technical solutions to meet partner and customer requirements.
Provide technical input for the preparation of customized proposals and ensure the necessary technical resources are allocated to support these activities.
Support the pre-sales team in conducting Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and delivering complex technical demonstrations to customers.
Deliver advanced technical training sessions to partners and customers.
Stay up to date with the software and hardware solutions distributed by the company, leveraging vendor documentation, industry reports, technical publications, and other relevant sources.
 Security Compliance and Standards
Apply security best practices and ensure alignment with international and local standards and regulations, including ISO/IEC 27001, NIST, GDPR , and applicable national IT security requirements.
 Requirements
 Professional Experience and Technical Expertise
Minimum 5 years of experience in designing and implementing network security solutions, particularly in firewall and NGFW configuration and deployment.
Hands-on experience with network security technologies from vendors such as Palo Alto Networks, Imperva, Radware, Cisco, Fortinet , or similar.
 Advanced Networking and Security Knowledge
In-depth understanding of networking protocols, including TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, and EIGRP , as well as security protocols such as SSL/TLS and IPsec .
Strong knowledge of encryption, authentication mechanisms, and data protection technologies.
 Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills
Ability to quickly and effectively analyze security threats, identify vulnerabilities, and recommend practical, reliable solutions.
 What We Offer
 Cutting-edge technologies: The opportunity to work in a dynamic technology environment with access to advanced cybersecurity solutions.
 Professional development: Access to technical training programs and industry certifications to support your career growth.
 Collaborative team of professionals: An open, supportive, and innovation-driven working environment.
 Competitive salary package. 
 Hybrid working model. 
 If you are passionate about network security and want to join a team committed to the highest security standards, apply for the Network Security Engineer position and contribute to protecting complex IT infrastructures.
